people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.
translations.bsb: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
translations.kjv: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
translations.asv: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was sore in the land.
